title: Left boundary row encoding
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be an alphabet, let $k\in\mathbb{N}$, and assign a Boolean head flag to each of the $k$ work tapes. The defined row consists of one blank sweep cell for each tape, with its head flag set to the assigned value and its preceding-block flag set to false.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean head flag for each tape
